items.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra tackles the Standard Model's toughest math problem on a lattice
items.description: OpenAI physicist Nathaniel Craig used GPT-6 Astra to tackle a problem that had stumped particle physicists for over 25 years. The AI model took Craig's strategy for defining the full Standard Model on a computational lattice and turned it into a working proof. Craig says a lot of work remains before realistic simulations are possible. items.description: Anthropic studied how Claude retains knowledge across sessions. Selective notes beat exhaustive archives by a wide margin. items.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
items.description: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton. items.description: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service.
